content: यजमान {%a.%} [यज्-शानच्] Sacrificing, worshipping. .{@-नः@} .²1 A person who performs a regular sacrifice and pays its expenses; जगाम यज्वा यजमानलोकम् <ls>R. 18. 12</ls>; ततः प्रविशति कुशानादाय यजमानशिष्यः <ls>Ś.</ls> .²2 A person who employs a priest or priests to sacrifice for him. .²3 (Hence) A host, patron, rich man. .²4 The head of a family. .²5 The head of a tribe.
